Key Announcements This Quarter
NVIDIA Blackwell and Wave of Data Center Scale Platforms Power the Trillion-Parameter Al Era
NVIDIA Blackwell enables real-time generative Al on trillionparameter large language models at up to 25x lower TCO and energy consumption than its predecessor
Blackwelldelivers up to 4x faster training and 3Ox faster inference than the H100
The unit of compute for the biggest LLMs is the GB200 NVL72- a multi-node, liquid-cooled, rack-scale system combining 36 GB200 Superchips to act as a single GPU
Each GB200 connects two NVIDIA B200 GPUs to a Grace CPU
The NVIDIA B200 GPU is the world's most powerful chip
Composed of two reticle limit dies connected by a 10 TB/s link into a single, unified GPU with 208 billion transistors
It powers the NVIDIA HGX B20O,a server platform with eight B200 GPUs interconnected with NVLink, for x86 systems
Amazon,Google,Meta, Microsoft, OpenAl, Oracle, Tesla and xAl are among the many organizations expected to adopt Blackwell
Blackwell products will be available starting later in 2024
New Wave of NVIDIA Networking Designed for Massive-Scale Al
NVIDIA Quantum-X800 InfiniBand and NVIDIA Spectrum-X800 Ethernet are the world's first networking platforms capable of end-to-end 800Gb/s throughput
The platforms feature software that accelerates Al, cloud, data processing and HPC applications in every type of data center, including new NVIDlA Blackwell product lineup
For the highest Al performance, GB2o0-powered systems can be connected with NVIDIA Quantum-X80O InfiniBand or Spectrum-X800 Ethernet switches
HGX B200 supports networking speeds up to 400Gb/s through the NVIDIA Quantum-2 InfiniBand and Spectrum-X Ethernet networking platforms
Initial adopters of Quantum InfiniBand and Spectrum-X include Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, CoreWeave
NVIDIA NIM Inference and CUDA-X Microservices
New cloud-native NVIDIA NIM microservices& CUDA-X microservices help developers quickly build & deploy Al & accelerated applications

NIM inference microservices provide pre-built containers powered by NVIDIA inference software一including Triton Inference Server and TensorRT-LLM一and industry-standard APls for domains such as language,speech& drug discovery
CUDA-X microservices provide end-to-end building blocks for data preparation, customization & training to speed production Al developmentacross industries.These include:

NVIDIA Riva for customizable speech & translation Al   
NVIDIA cuOpt for routing optimization   
NVIDIA Earth-2 for high resolution climate & weather simulations   
NeMo Retriever for linking Al applications to business data for retrieval

Adobe, Cadence, CrowdStrike, Getty Images, SAP, ServiceNow, Shutterstock are among the first to access the new microservices

Leading transportation companies choose NVIDlA DRiVE Thor to power their next-gen consumer & commercial fleets, from new energy vehicles & trucks to robotaxis, robobuses & last-mile autonomous delivery vehicles

DRIVE Thor isa centralized in-vehicle computing platform based on Blackwell. It delivers feature-rich cockpit capabilities plus safe & secure highly automated and autonomous driving BYD, GAC AlON, XPENG, Plus, Nuro, Waabi, WeRide are adopting DRIVE Thor, joining Li Auto& ZEEKR DRIVE Thor slated for production vehicles as early as 2025

NVIDIA H20O Tensor Core GPUs and NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM Set MLPerf LLM Inference Records

In the latest MLPerf benchmark for Al inference, NVIDIA Hopper swept every test of Al inference on a per accelerator basis, demonstrating the power of NVIDlA's full-stack platform of chips, systems and software to handle the demanding requirements of running gen Al
NVIDIA was the only company to submit results on every Workload in the latest round and every round since MLPerf's inference benchmarks began in October 2020

NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM一our software that speeds and simplifies the complex job of inference on large language models-boosted the performance of NVIDIA Hopper on GPT-J LLM nearly 3x over their results just six months ago
NVIDIA H2OO GPUs, in their MLPerf debut, set a record on the Llama 2 70B benchmark
NVIDIA Sweeps New Ranking of World's Most Energy-Efficient Supercomputers
In the latest ranking of the world's most energy-efficient supercomputers -the Green500 - NVIDIA-powered systems swept the top 3 spots,and took 7 of the top 10
The strong showing demonstrates how accelerated computing represents the most energy-efficient method for high-performance computing
The top three systems were allpowered by the NVIDIA GH2OO Grace Hopper Superchip,offering over 1,OOOx more energy efficiency on mixed precision and Al tasks than previous generations
Accelerated computing has proven to be the cornerstone of energy efficiency, with majority of the systems on the Green5OO list - including 40 of the top 50 一 now featuring it

NVIDIA's upcoming Blackwell platform offers the computational power of the Titan supercomputer launched 10 years ago 一a \$100M system the size of a tennis court - yet efficient enough to be powered by a wall socket just like a typical home appliance
